cli_all_requires_mock:
--all requires --mock.
  On real hardware, "every module installed on this station" is not a test definition: installing a module silently changes what runs, and nothing records what was executed.
  Use --recipe FILE for a sequence, or --run MODULE_ID for one module.
cli_banner: 🛠️  nRF DTM & PPK Pure Python CLI Test Runner
cli_card_wip_requires_mock: Card "{card}" ({name}) is under development (WIP). Run with --mock to test.
cli_menu_all_requires_mock:
⚠️  Running every installed module is available in mock simulation only.
   On real hardware a sequence must come from a recipe, so that what ran is
   recorded and fingerprinted. Use menu item 1 to load a recipe file, or
   menu item 2 to run a single test. Menu item 5 enables mock simulation.
cli_menu_recipe: 1. Run a recipe file (a recorded sequence)
cli_needs_target: ❌ Nothing to run. Add --all, --run MODULE_ID or --recipe FILE (--help for details).
cli_not_a_number: ⚠️ Not a number. Using the default {value}.

tooltip_seq_repeat:
How many times to repeat the whole sequence.
Each run is recorded separately in the trace log.
Set 0 (∞) to repeat until stopped - for burn-in.

To repeat a single card only, use 'Repeat count for this card' in the card's ⚙️ settings.
